about: Every number the README's charts plot and its text cites, written by coldivf-bench/py/charts.py. The 1M and 10M head-to-head charts come from their suites' results through headtohead.py, and the chart of ColdIVF in each setup on Cohere 1M from the quiet run in results/quiet2.

charts.title: Cold first query at 1M vectors, recall@10 0.95
charts.subtitle: The first 1M rows of cohere10m-768-cosine (Cohere 10M, 768 dimensions, cosine, 1,000 queries), on one Apple M3 Pro with 36 GB of memory. Each dot is the p50 of 30 to 300 true-cold trials, each a fresh process with the index evicted from the cache, and its line runs to the p99. Each system runs at its pick for recall@10 0.95, whose recall over the 500 test queries is 0.956 to 1.000. Log scale.
charts.footer: ColdIVF runs through its Python module, as every other system runs through its binding, and each trial first searches a small index of its own config. Indexes that load whole at open, and the in-memory graphs, read most of their index before the first query. A system's trials time at most 50 distinct test queries, so a p99 shows the spread over repeats of them. Rows with fewer queries time a subset of them, which differs from system to system, so the ratios paired by query compare only the queries both timed.
notes: Each row is headtohead.py's pick for the target, pick.py's verdict rule on the tune split, measured on the test split.

p50_ratio is the row's C0 p50 over ColdIVF's at the same target, paired_ratio the median of per-query ratios over the queries both timed with its 95% bootstrap interval, and exact_ratio the ratio of the two p50s at exactly the target, where both have cells around it.

charts.subtitle: The first 1M rows of cohere10m-768-cosine (Cohere 10M, 768 dimensions, cosine, 1,000 queries), on one Apple M3 Pro with 36 GB of memory. ColdIVF's module has no batch call.

charts.title: Memory at 1M vectors
charts.subtitle: The first 1M rows of cohere10m-768-cosine (Cohere 10M, 768 dimensions, cosine, 1,000 queries), on one Apple M3 Pro with 36 GB of memory. Each system at its pick for recall@10 0.95, or 0.90 where it doesn't reach 0.95, and turbovec calibrated at its setting of most recall, since it reaches neither. Cold is the median of its trials of what the open and the first query add to the process, plus the index's pages they bring into the page cache. charts.footer: Pages an index copies into its own memory at open count once, in the process. Setups that search another setup's file show that file's build. Every build ran with macOS malloc's cache of freed large blocks off, so no build peak holds freed memory.

charts.title: Memory at 10M vectors
charts.subtitle: 10M vectors of cohere10m-768-cosine (Cohere 10M, 768 dimensions, cosine, 1,000 queries), on one Apple M3 Pro with 36 GB of memory. Each system at its pick for recall@10 0.95, or 0.90 where it doesn't reach 0.95, and usearch HNSW i8 at its setting of most recall, since it reaches neither. Cold is the median of its trials of what the open and the first query add to the process, plus the index's pages they bring into the page cache. Warm is the process plus the cached pages of its index files, with every file read first.
charts.footer: Pages an index copies into its own memory at open count once, in the process. LanceDB's warm runs cache only its index files and leave its 30.7 GB table on disk. The builds of ColdIVF, DiskANN and turbovec calibrated ran with macOS malloc's cache of freed large blocks off, and the other builds with it on, which keeps freed blocks inside their peaks.

charts.title: ColdIVF's cold first query in each setup, recall@10 near 0.95
legend: Controls, ColdIVF's file read another way
charts.footer: A prewarmed core spins for 150 ms before the query, and an idle core sleeps 200 ms first, so its query can start on an efficiency core. The driver runs a fresh process per trial with the index evicted, and the own harness is ColdIVF's cold binary. After a search of another index, the process has first searched a 50K index of its own. The lazy map searches ColdIVF's file through a memory map that faults pages in, at the control's setting rather than its cheapest one.
notes: Each row runs at a setting whose recall@10 reaches 0.95 warm. Of those timed cold, it is the one with the most trials, and of those with as many, the cheapest warm, the lowest p50 and then the fewest bytes scanned, as pick.py ranks settings.
Every row is ColdIVF's index, timed through the driver or ColdIVF's own cold binary, with the read path and the state before the query that its label names.
Each p50_ratio is the row's p50 over ColdIVF's through the driver, and a control's over the read waves that its own job interleaved with it, at the same setting and CPU state.
